title: Tickets Available for Godzilla Minus Zero in UK in November
content:
Tickets are available for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , at https://godzillafilm.co.uk/ . The film will open in IMAX cinemas on November 3, and in general cinemas on November 6.

The London Film Festival describes the film as follows:

"Japan, 1949. Pilot Kōichi, his wife Noriko and adoptive daughter Akiko are attempting from recover from Godzilla's recent attacks. But just as everything seems settled, a new danger emerges. Meanwhile, at the bottom of the sea, something is stirring. The first Japanese film to be shot for IMAX, Godzilla Minus Zero combines high-octane thrills with more than a little heart."

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Production was at TOHO Studios, with ROBOT producing the film and Shirogumi Inc. handling the visual effects.

title: Crunchyroll Manga Launches in India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka
content:
The Crunchyroll Anime Future Forum announced on Thursday that the company is launching Crunchyroll Manga in India. The service will also launch in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Bangladesh, Bhutan, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Australia, and New Zealand.

The platform is launching with 250 English titles from J-Novel Club , Square Enix , and Yen Press . Titles from VIZ will launch at a later date.

The company is launching a new subscription tier called "Ultimate Fan" that will include access to the manga platform along with anime streaming.

The Crunchyroll Manga app launched on iOS and Android devices in the United States and Canada in October 2025. The ad-free app is separate from the main Crunchyroll streaming service.

Crunchyroll is discontinuing its main app on the Nintendo Switch on October 30. Crunchyroll is still available on Xbox and PlayStation , as well as on mobile devices, media players, Smart TVs and TVs, service providers, and via web browsers.

Crunchyroll updated its logo, branding, font, and glyphs in July 2024.

Crunchyroll announced its first slate of Hindi and Indian English dubs in November 2022 as it introduced subscription tiers for Indian audiences. It established its second office in India in March 2024. The company began streaming several of its anime titles in India on March 1, 2022. Funimation and Crunchyroll announced on the same day that Funimation and Wakanim 's anime library and simulcast content had moved to Crunchyroll . The company appointed Rahul Purini as CEO in April 2022 after several years as COO of Funimation . Amazon Prime Video added Crunchyroll as an add-on subscription in June 2024.

title: J.C. Staff Animates Teenage Mercenary Webtoon for 2027 Broadcast
content:
Crunchyroll announced at New York Comic Con on Friday that J.C. Staff is animating the previously announced adaptation of YC and Rakyeon's original webtoon Teenage Mercenary (Nyūgaku Yōhei in Japanese) for broadcast next year.

Manabu Ono ( Sword Art Online: Alicization ) is directing and overseeing the series scripts, and Koji Haneda is designing the characters. Hiroyuki Sawano is composing the music. Hayate is producing the project.

WEBTOON started publishing the series in English in June 2021 and describes the story:

At the age of eight, Yu Ijin (Sōma Tatewaki in Japanese version) lost his parents in a plane crash and became stranded in a foreign land, forced to become a child mercenary in order to stay alive. He returns home ten years later to be reunited with his family in Korea, where food and shelter are plenty and everything seems peaceful. But Ijin will soon learn that life as a teenager is a whole other feat of survival. With only one year of high school left, Ijin must master new tactics to maneuver his way around the schoolhouse battleground. Can he survive a year of high school? Or rather, will the school be able to survive him?

The series launched in Korean on Naver Webtoon in November 2020. The series then launched on LINE Manga in Japan in April 2021, and has a cumulative domestic view count of over 730 million (as of May 2025). The series won first place in the " LINE Manga 2023 Annual Ranking," and also the next year in the " LINE Manga 2024 Annual Ranking (serialized)."

The series is distributed in 10 languages and has over 2.84 billion views worldwide (as of September 2026).

title: The Remarried Empress Webtoon Gets TV Anime From TROYCA in 2027
content:
Crunchyroll announced at New York Comic Con on Friday a television anime adaptation of HereLee and SUMPUL 's webtoon The Remarried Empress . (The webtoon is itself based on Alphatart 's original web novel.) TROYCA is animating the project for broadcast next year.

The main cast members are:

• Yōko Hikasa as Navier

• Ryōhei Kimura as Heinrey

• Tomoaki Maeno as Sovieshu

• Reina Ueda as Rashta

Tetsuya Yanagisawa is directing the anime at TROYCA , and Akiko Inoue is supervising and writing the series scripts. Jun Nakai is designing the characters, and Yūki Fukazawa is composing the music.

The romantic fantasy revolves around Navier, the perfect Empress of the Eastern Empire, who chooses divorce after discovering that her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, plans to replace her with his mistress. Determined to reclaim her status, Navier resolves to become an Empress in another land.

The webtoon has over 2.97 billion global views and has been translated into 10 languages. The series has a strong international following, particularly in Japan.

The webtoon ended in January after a seven-year run, but will return this fall for side stories.

The English version of the The Remarried Empress webtoon is available on WEBTOON. Ize Press is releasing the series in print.

The webtoon is also inspiring a live-action series which will premiere on Disney+ and Hulu on November 4, and the services will release two new episodes every Wednesday through the series finale on November 25 (for a total of 10 episodes).

title: 'Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content:
The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, and a promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta ( The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All ) manga on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on January 8 at 11:00 p.m. on NTV's Friday Anime Night timeslot.

Cast Joe: Kenjirou Tsuda ( Gokushufudou ) Narita: Tasuku Hatanaka ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Chizuru: Yurina Amami ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. ) Mao: Fairouz Ai ( Chainsaw Man ) Kanna: Maiko Nomura ( Tsuma, Shougakusei ni Naru. )

Kousuke Noma and Takayuki "Koujirou" Sasaki are joining the staff as music composers.

Masashi Ishihama ( Horimiya ) is directing the anime at CloverWorks . Rino Yamazaki ( Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku ) is handling the series composition and Kanna Hirayama ( [Oshi no Ko] ) is designing the characters.

Arai originally began posting the music-themed girls love manga, also known by its short title Kinioto , on their X (formerly Twitter) account in April 2022. Kadokawa began printing the manga in April 2023 and published the fourth volume last February. The fifth volume is planned to be released on January 13.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in April 2024 and released the first volume in October that year. The third volume went on sale in December 2025, with the fourth volume scheduled to be released on October 27. The manga is also published in multiple foreign languages, including Spanish, Italian, Polish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

title: Webtoon 'The Boxer' Gets TV Anime
content:
The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Ji-Hoon Jeong 's The Boxer webtoon on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a special promotional trailer.

Cast Yu: Kouki Uchiyama ( Blue Lock ) J: Toshiyuki Toyonaga ( Bungou Stray Dogs ) K: Tomokazu Seki ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Ryu Baeksan: Kensho Ono ( Vinland Saga )

Staff Director: Takehiro Kubota ( Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon ), Won-yeong Kang ( Cardfight!! Vanguard: overDress main animation) Character Design: Masahiro Suwa ( Made in Abyss ) Series Composition/Script: Toshiya Oono ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) Creative Producer: Blue Rights Producer: Hayate Co-Producer: Naver Webtoons , Crunchyroll , Xtorm Studio: breccia , Studio Jemi

Jeong serialized the sports drama webtoon on the Naver Webtoon platform from December 2019 to May 2022. Daewon C.I. published the 13th and final volume in September 2025.

Line Webtoon published the series digitally in English from May 2020. Yen Press licenced the series in July 2022 and published the 13th volume on May 19.

Synopsis Having suffered ruthless bullying for the better part of his life, 17-year-old Yu has become emotionally numb and dissociated from reality, no longer able to act like a normal human being. Although he possesses the exceptional talent to dodge punches, Yu prefers to let his perpetrators beat him down as he finds no meaning in his survival.

Things begin to look up when Yu meets an old boxing trainer nicknamed "K." Having raised five champions, K's years of experience and an impressive gut feeling allow him to recognize Yu's near-superhuman fighting charisma immediately. K rushes to take Yu under his wing, despite the latter's apparent lack of interest.

However, after being reminded of a bright memory from the past, Yu has a change of heart and accepts K's offer, hoping to experience the same light once again. Thus, Yu enters a world full of formidable adversaries—righteous and monstrous alike—and for the first time ever, he has no choice but to fight back. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Webtoon 'The Remarried Empress' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Alphatart and Sumpul 's The Remarried Princess webtoon on Thursday and revealed the main cast, staff, a fourth character visual (pictured), and special promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Cast Navier: Youko Hikasa ( High School DxD ) Heinrey: Ryouhei Kimura ( Grand Blue ) Sovieshu: Tomoaki Maeno ( Akatsuki no Yona ) Rashta: Reina Ueda ( Chainsaw Man )

Staff Director: Tetsuya Yanagisawa ( Boushoku no Berserk ) Series Composition, Script: Akiko Inoue ( Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. ) Character Design: Jun Nakai ( NieR:Automata Ver1.1a ) Music: Yuuki Fukazawa Studio: TROYCA Producer: Hayate

Alphatart originally published the fantasy romance web novel on the Naver Web Novel platform from November 2018 to March 2020. Happy Books to You published the eighth and final volume in December 2022.

HereLee adapted the novel into a webtoon illustrated by Sumpul. The webtoon began serialization on the Naver Webtoon platform in October 2019 and concluded with 251 chapters on January 1. Young Com released the 11th volume on August 31.

Line Webtoon began publishing the webtoon digitally in English in September 2020. Yen Press licensed the webtoon for English print under its Ize Press imprint in July 2022. The tenth volume went on sale on June 16, with the 11th volume scheduled for an October 20 release. The series boasts over 630 million cumulative views in Japan and over 2.97 billion cumulative views globally.

A live-action television series adaptation of the webtoon was announced in April 2025. The series is produced by Studio N and is scheduled to premiere on Disney+ on November 4.

Synopsis Empress of the Eastern Nation Navier Ellie Trovi stands at the pinnacle of noblewomen with dignity and grace. Although she and her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, are not as intimate as other couples, their trust in each other has been built over years of friendship. But then, wanting something more, he brings in a concubine—a former slave named Rashta—and that is when everything begins to fall apart.

Months later, the fateful day arrives; Sovieshu declares his intentions to divorce Navier and give her throne to Rashta. However, against all expectations, Navier is not backed against a wall, and she declares her intention to marry another man—Heinrey—whose noble appearance shocks all in the room.

Just who is Heinrey, and how did Navier come to this new marriage arrangement? The Eastern Nation stands at a precipice, being torn apart by conspiracies, lies, and—above all—love. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Announces 2 Cast, Additional Staff Members, 2028 Delay
content:
Additional staff members include music composer Keiji Inai ( Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? , This Monster Wants to Eat Me , The Beginning After The End ), sound director Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure , KONOSUBA – God's blessing on this wonderful world!! ), and sound effects artist Yasumasa Koyama ( Ajin , Brave Bang Bravern! , Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works ). Calligrapher Gyousyou Suzuki, who also worked in the lettering and calligraphy supervision of the Barakamon anime, also worked on the calligraphy of the anime's title " Kuroudo Kitan. "

The anime was first announced to debut exclusively on Crunchyroll in 2027.

Takanobu Mizuno ( Star Wars: Visions "The Duel" short) is directing the anime at Kamikaze Douga ( Star Wars: Visions "The Duel" short, Batman Ninja , Sand Land , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure opening sequences). Satoshi Maejima and Gen Urobuchi are writing the script (Urobuchi was previously also announced for story composition), and Takashi Okazaki is the character designer. HAYATE Inc. is overseeing production. Aniplex is collaborating on the anime, and Sony Music is the "music and soundtrack partner."

Sucker Punch Productions and SIE released Ghost of Tsushima on PlayStation 4 in July 2020, on PlayStation 5 in August 2021, and on PC in May 2024. The game is a fictionalization of the historical 1274 Mongol invasion of the island of Tsushima, and follows samurai Jin Sakai, the sole survivor of his clan, as he fights a guerilla war against the invading Mongols. The game has a sequel titled Ghost of Yōtei that launched in October 2025, with the story set more than 300 years later in 1603 in Hokkaido.

Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is a multiplayer addition to the original game that debuted in October 2020, and became available separate from the original game in September 2021. Unlike the historical setting of the original game, the multiplayer game focuses on Japanese folklore and mythology.

title: The Boxer TV Anime Announced With Koki Uchiyama, Kensho Ono, Tomokazu Seki and Toshiyuki Toyonaga
content:
JH’s WEBTOON series The Boxer is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. A special announcement trailer was revealed alongside the main cast and production staff during the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026.

Koki Uchiyama will voice protagonist Yu, a boxer whose overwhelming natural ability allows him to rise rapidly through the sport. Kensho Ono will voice Ryu, a naturally gifted boxer who becomes Yu’s first opponent. Tomokazu Seki will play legendary trainer K, who discovers Yu’s extraordinary potential, while Toshiyuki Toyonaga will voice J, a legendary boxer who has already retired.

Crunchyroll describes the story:

A talent bestowed upon a monster. Is it a blessing—or a curse? K, a legendary boxing trainer who has produced numerous world champions, is searching for his “final disciple.” Then he encounters Yu, a boy in a back alley who simply stands there, taking punch after punch. The boy shows neither anger nor fighting spirit, yet K sees in him something beyond genius: a talent of unfathomable potential. Under K’s guidance, Yu steps into the boxing ring. With an overwhelming strength that can only be described as monstrous, he begins his ascent toward the pinnacle of the boxing world. Standing in his way are champions who stake their pride on skills honed to perfection, and fighters who have overcome the limits of talent through sheer effort. Each carries a dream they refuse to surrender and a reason to keep fighting. Their clashes with the monster shake even the foundations of the lives they have built. And what does Yu himself seek at the end of his fists? The life of one “monster” intertwines with the lives of those who fight him. Beyond talent and hard work, glory and defeat, a story begins—one that asks what it truly means to be strong.

Yudai Kubota and KANG Wonyeong are directing the anime. Masahiro Suwa is handling the character designs, while Toshiya Ono is in charge of the series composition and scripts. Animation production is being handled jointly by breccia, a new studio founded by Kinema Citrus founding member Muneki Ogasawara, and South Korea-based STUDIO JEMI.

The Boxer originally began serialization on South Korea’s NAVER WEBTOON in 2019 and ran on Japan’s LINE Manga from 2020 to 2022. The series has surpassed 1.06 billion cumulative views worldwide. A print edition reformatted from its vertical full-color WEBTOON presentation has also been published in Japan under Shueisha’s Jump Comics label, with six volumes released.

The anime is one of the titles being developed under the newly announced partnership between HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier and Crunchyroll, which plans to work on potential anime adaptations of around 15 WEBTOON series.
author: Anime Corner

contentBlocks.text: JH’s WEBTOON series The Boxer is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. A special announcement trailer was revealed alongside the main cast and production staff during the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026.

Koki Uchiyama will voice protagonist Yu, a boxer whose overwhelming natural ability allows him to rise rapidly through the sport. Kensho Ono will voice Ryu, a naturally gifted boxer who becomes Yu’s first opponent. Tomokazu Seki will play legendary trainer K, who discovers Yu’s extraordinary potential, while Toshiyuki Toyonaga will voice J, a legendary boxer who has already retired.
Crunchyroll describes the story:

A talent bestowed upon a monster. Is it a blessing—or a curse? K, a legendary boxing trainer who has produced numerous world champions, is searching for his “final disciple.” Then he encounters Yu, a boy in a back alley who simply stands there, taking punch after punch. The boy shows neither anger nor fighting spirit, yet K sees in him something beyond genius: a talent of unfathomable potential. Under K’s guidance, Yu steps into the boxing ring. With an overwhelming strength that can only be described as monstrous, he begins his ascent toward the pinnacle of the boxing world. Standing in his way are champions who stake their pride on skills honed to perfection, and fighters who have overcome the limits of talent through sheer effort. Each carries a dream they refuse to surrender and a reason to keep fighting. Their clashes with the monster shake even the foundations of the lives they have built. And what does Yu himself seek at the end of his fists? The life of one “monster” intertwines with the lives of those who fight him. Beyond talent and hard work, glory and defeat, a story begins—one that asks what it truly means to be strong.

Yudai Kubota and KANG Wonyeong are directing the anime. Masahiro Suwa is handling the character designs, while Toshiya Ono is in charge of the series composition and scripts. Animation production is being handled jointly by breccia, a new studio founded by Kinema Citrus founding member Muneki Ogasawara, and South Korea-based STUDIO JEMI.

The Boxer originally began serialization on South Korea’s NAVER WEBTOON in 2019 and ran on Japan’s LINE Manga from 2020 to 2022. The series has surpassed 1.06 billion cumulative views worldwide. A print edition reformatted from its vertical full-color WEBTOON presentation has also been published in Japan under Shueisha’s Jump Comics label, with six volumes released.

The anime is one of the titles being developed under the newly announced partnership between HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier and Crunchyroll, which plans to work on potential anime adaptations of around 15 WEBTOON series.

title: JH's The Boxer Webtoon Gets TV Anime
content:
Crunchyroll announced at its panel at New York Comic Con on Thursday that JH's The Boxer webtoon is getting a television anime adaptation from new Japanese anime studio breccia and Korean animation studio Studio Jemi .

breccia is a new anime studio founded by Kinema Citrus founding member and producer Muneki Ogasawara .

Takehiro Kubota ( My Happy Marriage anime franchise) and Won Yeong Kang ( Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress , Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress key animator and main animator) are both directing the anime. Masahiro Suwa ( The Rising of The Shield Hero anime franchise) is designing the characters, and Toshiya Ono ( 86 , The Promised Neverland , Blue Exorcist: Kyoto Saga ) is both overseeing and writing the series scripts. BLUE RIGHTS is the creative producer. HAYATE Inc., the new anime production venture from Aniplex and Crunchyroll , is producing the anime. Co-producers include LINE Manga, Crunchyroll , XTORM, and BLUE RIGHTS .

The anime will star:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Yu

• Kenshō Ono as Ryu

• Tomokazu Seki as K

• Toshiyuki Toyonaga as J

While searching for a final prodigy to train, legendary boxing coach K stumbles across a bewildering scene—an apathetic teenager simply standing still as his bullies throttle him. But Coach K sees more than this, sees the precision, grace, and uncanny perceptiveness in the boy's movements. He knows right away that this is the fighter he's been waiting for. Yet when he tries to recruit him, the boy with the lifeless eyes only asks one question: “Is it any fun? Hitting people…Is it fun?”

The series originally launched on Naver Webtoon in Korea in 2019. The series has more than 1.06 billion views globally as of September, and won an award at the World Webtoon Awards in 2024.

Ji-hoon Jeong (penname JH) is also known for the The Horizon webtoon, which WEBTOON released in English digitally and Yen Press released in print. The series was honored with the Yellow Kid “Book of the Year” award at Italy's Lucca Comics & Games festival in November 2025.

JH launched the Umbilical webtoon in December, and it is his first new series in three years since the conclusion of The Boxer .
